source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Teach workers to recognize workplace hazards and use the controls and safe practices required","B":"Replace engineering controls with education so employers no longer need to correct physical hazards","C":"Focus only on productivity because worker training has little relationship to injury prevention","D":"Limit hazard information to supervisors so frontline workers are not burdened with safety details"}}
source_row.rationale: OSHA identifies education and training as a core element of safety and health programs. Workers need information and skills to recognize hazards, understand controls, and perform work safely.
source_row.source_detail: Core element: train workers to identify hazards, understand controls, and work safely; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: OSHA — Education and Training, Recommended Practices for Safety and Health Programs
source_row.stem: A community health nurse is helping an employer plan worker safety education. What is a core purpose of effective safety training?
